搭建球棍模型认识有机化合物分子结构 · 3D 互动课件: Ball-and-Stick Models of Organic Molecules · Interactive 3D Lesson
碳四价：每个碳成 4 个共价键: Carbon is tetravalent: each carbon forms 4 covalent bonds
分子画在纸上是平的，真实的三维形状到底是什么样？搭一座球棍模型能看出什么？: Molecules drawn on paper look flat. What is their real 3D shape, and what can a ball-and-stick model show us?
每个碳接 4 个键，每个氢接 1 个: Each carbon takes 4 bonds, each hydrogen takes 1
甲烷的 4 个键夹角 109°28′: The 4 bonds of methane meet at 109°28′
σ 键绕键轴转不破键，π 键不能: A σ bond can rotate about its axis without breaking; a π bond cannot
碳连成链，同分子式可有两种骨架: Carbons join into chains; one formula can have two skeletons
双键 120° 共面、三键 180° 共线、苯等长: Double bond 120° and planar, triple bond 180° and linear, benzene bonds equal
碳球 4 个接口、氢球 1 个接口，盒里还有氯球和长短两种棍: Carbon balls have 4 sockets, hydrogen balls have 1; the box also holds chlorine balls and long and short sticks
正四面体：碳在中心，4 个氢在 4 个顶点: Regular tetrahedron: carbon at the center, 4 hydrogens at the 4 vertices
碳可以一个接一个连成链，键角仍是一样大: Carbons can link one after another into a chain, and the bond angle stays the same
双键把原子压到一个平面，三键把它压成一条线: A double bond forces atoms into a plane; a triple bond forces them into a line
平面正六边形，6 个碳碳键完全等同: Planar regular hexagon with 6 identical carbon-carbon bonds
双键、三键：绕键轴转不动（二面角恒为 0°）: Double and triple bonds: no rotation about the bond axis (dihedral angle stays 0°)
盒里的碳球为什么要留 4 个接口，氢球只有 1 个？: Why does the carbon ball in the box have 4 sockets, but the hydrogen ball only 1?
点一下盒前那颗放大的碳球，看它的 4 个接口: Click the enlarged carbon ball in front of the box and look at its 4 sockets
4 个接口一起亮起来；氢球只有 1 个接口，正好对应碳成 4 个键、氢成 1 个: All 4 sockets light up; the hydrogen ball has just 1, matching carbon's 4 bonds and hydrogen's 1 bond
碳原子最外层有 4 个电子，能形成 4 个共价键；氢只能形成 1 个。这就是「碳: A carbon atom has 4 outer electrons and can form 4 covalent bonds; hydrogen can form only 1. This is "tetravalent carbon", which is why open-chain alkanes have the formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂.
碳原子以最外层的 4 个电子，分别与别的原子形成 4 个共价键。: A carbon atom uses its 4 outer electrons to form 4 covalent bonds with other atoms.
碳与碳之间也能成键，可以成单键、双键或三键。: Carbon can also bond to carbon, through single, double or triple bonds.
氢原子只能形成 1 个共价键，所以氢球只有 1 个接口。: A hydrogen atom can form only 1 covalent bond, so the hydrogen ball has just 1 socket.
去掉这一步：会以为接口数只是造型，不知道碳四价是搭模型的硬约束。: Skip this step and you may think the socket count is just styling, missing that tetravalent carbon is a hard rule for building models.
考点：碳四价；链状烷烃通式 CₙH₂ₙ₊₂。: Key point: tetravalent carbon; general formula of open-chain alkanes CₙH₂ₙ₊₂.
甲烷的 4 个氢，凭什么说它们完全一样？: How can we say the 4 hydrogens of methane are exactly alike?
把甲烷转一圈，看 4 个氢是不是真的一样大、一样远: Spin methane all the way around and check whether the 4 hydrogens are really equal in size and distance
转到任何角度，4 根 C—H 一样长、6 对 H—C—H 角都是 109°28′: At any angle, all 4 C—H bonds are equally long and all 6 H—C—H angles are 109°28′; the 5 atoms can never lie flat (switch to "space-filling model" to compare with the other model in textbook Fig. 7-5)
甲烷是正四面体：碳在中心，4 个氢在 4 个顶点，键角 109°28′（也就是: Methane is a regular tetrahedron: carbon at the center, 4 hydrogens at the 4 vertices, bond angle 109°28′ (that is, 109.47°), and the 5 atoms are not in one plane. Because the 4 vertices are fully equivalent, the 4 hydrogens are exactly alike. (The bond-angle value comes from Elective 2 "Structure and Properties of Matter"; Compulsory Book 2 only requires that "the 4 bonds make equal angles with each other".)
甲烷不是平面正方形，是正四面体。: Methane is not a flat square; it is a regular tetrahedron.
4 个 C—H 键长都是 109 pm，6 对 H—C—H 角都是 109°28: All 4 C—H bonds are 109 pm long, and all 6 H—C—H angles are 109°28′.
5 个原子不在同一平面上。: The 5 atoms are not in the same plane.
去掉这一步：会按平面正方形想象甲烷，下一步的二氯甲烷就会判错。: Skip this step and you may picture methane as a flat square, then misjudge dichloromethane in the next step.
考点：甲烷的正四面体结构、键角 109°28′。: Key point: the tetrahedral structure of methane, bond angle 109°28′.
正四面体 · 碳在中心: Regular tetrahedron · carbon at the center
把甲烷的两个氢换成氯，能有几种搭法？: Replace two hydrogens of methane with chlorine. How many ways can it be built?
把「氯取代」拨到开，看两个绿球怎么摆: Turn "chlorine substitution" on and see where the two green balls go
两个氯球出现；无论怎么转，两个氯的相对位置都一样，只有一种摆法: Two chlorine balls appear; however you turn it, the two chlorines sit in the same relative position: only one arrangement
二氯甲烷只有一种结构，没有同分异构体——模型按正四面体搭，4 个顶点完全等价，换: Dichloromethane has only one structure and no isomers. Built as a regular tetrahedron, the model has 4 fully equivalent vertices, so replacing any two hydrogens gives the same structure. Question 2 of the textbook's Lab Activity 8 "Questions and discussion" uses ball-and-stick models to check exactly this.
正四面体 4 个顶点等价，换哪两个氢都得到同一个分子。: The 4 vertices of a tetrahedron are equivalent, so replacing any two hydrogens gives the same molecule.
模型按正四面体搭，4 个顶点等价；换哪两个 H 都是同一种结构。（拓展：真实的: The model is built as a regular tetrahedron with 4 equivalent vertices, so replacing any two H gives the same structure. (Extension: real CH₂Cl₂ is not a regular tetrahedron; Cl—C—Cl is about 112°, so this lesson does not give it a bond angle.)
如果甲烷真是平面正方形，二氯甲烷就会有邻位、对位两种结构。: If methane really were a flat square, dichloromethane would have two structures: adjacent and opposite.
去掉这一步：模型只剩下好看，学不到用模型排除错误结构。: Skip this step and the model is only pretty; you miss using models to rule out wrong structures.
考点：二氯甲烷没有同分异构体（高频错点）。: Key point: dichloromethane has no isomers (a frequent mistake).
正四面体 4 个顶点等价: The 4 vertices of a tetrahedron are equivalent
把乙烷的 C—C 键扭一下，分子还是同一个吗？: Twist the C—C bond of ethane. Is it still the same molecule?
二面角从 0° 转到 180°，可 4 个 H—C—C 的夹角一直是 109°2: The dihedral angle turns from 0° to 180°, yet all 4 H—C—C angles stay 109°28′ and the molecule's shape does not change
C—C 单键可以绕键轴自由旋转；转的只是同一个分子的不同姿态，分子本身没变，不算: A C—C single bond can rotate freely about its axis; rotation only gives different poses of the same molecule, so it is not isomerism. Double and triple bonds cannot rotate, which is why ethene is locked into a plane and ethyne into a line.
单键可以绕键轴旋转，转的过程中化学键不会被破坏。: A single bond can rotate about its axis without breaking the bond.
旋转改变的只是构象，分子还是同一个分子。: Rotation changes only the conformation; it is still the same molecule.
（拓展 · 选必3 p.6）单键是 σ 键，σ 键可绕键轴旋转；双键、三键里有: (Extension · Elective 3 p.6) A single bond is a σ bond, which can rotate about its axis; double and triple bonds contain π bonds, which cannot.
去掉这一步：会把「转一下」误当成生成了新物质。: Skip this step and you may mistake a twist for making a new substance.
考点：σ 键可绕键轴旋转、π 键一定不能。: Key point: σ bonds can rotate about the bond axis; π bonds cannot.
σ 键可绕键轴旋转: σ bonds can rotate about the axis
单键转得动 · 双键三键转不动: Single bonds rotate · double and triple bonds do not
碳原子能不能一个接一个接下去？: Can carbon atoms keep linking one after another?
把「当前分子」从乙烷一路拖到丁烷: Drag "current molecule" from ethane all the way to butane
原子数 8 → 11 → 14，分子式一路 C₂H₆ → C₃H₈ → C₄H₁: Atom count 8 → 11 → 14, formula C₂H₆ → C₃H₈ → C₄H₁₀, while the bond angle stays 109°28′
碳原子可以相互连成链，链越长原子越多；链状饱和烃的通式是 CₙH₂ₙ₊₂。链变长: Carbon atoms can link into chains; the longer the chain, the more atoms. Open-chain saturated hydrocarbons follow CₙH₂ₙ₊₂. The chain grows, yet every carbon is still tetrahedral with bond angles of 109°28′.
碳可以连成直链，也可以连成带支链或成环的骨架。: Carbon can form straight chains, branched chains or rings.
原子数随碳原子数增加，键角始终不变。: The atom count rises with the number of carbons; the bond angle never changes.
链状烷烃通式 CₙH₂ₙ₊₂，相邻同系物相差一个 CH₂。: Open-chain alkanes follow CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, and neighboring homologues differ by one CH₂.
去掉这一步：会以为分子越大、键角就越大。: Skip this step and you may think bigger molecules have bigger bond angles.
考点：烷烃通式 CₙH₂ₙ₊₂、同系物。: Key point: alkane formula CₙH₂ₙ₊₂, homologous series.
同样 4 个碳、10 个氢，为什么能搭出两个不同的分子？: With the same 4 carbons and 10 hydrogens, why can two different molecules be built?
把「支链」拨到开，把直链的丁烷换成带支链的: Turn "branch" on to swap straight-chain butane for a branched one
原子数还是 14、分子式还是 C₄H₁₀、键长键角都没变；变的是碳骨架：末端甲基: Still 14 atoms, still C₄H₁₀, same bond lengths and angles; what changes is the carbon skeleton: end methyl groups go from 2 to 3
分子式相同、结构不同的两种化合物互为同分异构体：正丁烷是直链，异丁烷带支链。骨架: Two compounds with the same formula but different structures are isomers: n-butane is a straight chain, isobutane is branched. Different skeletons mean different properties: n-butane boils at −0.5 ℃, isobutane at −11.6 ℃.
同分异构体：分子式相同、结构不同。: Isomers: same molecular formula, different structure.
正丁烷是直链，异丁烷带支链，末端甲基 2 个对 3 个。: n-Butane is a straight chain, isobutane is branched: 2 versus 3 end methyl groups.
去掉这一步：会以为分子式相同就是同一种物质。: Skip this step and you may think the same formula means the same substance.
为什么乙烯的 6 个原子挤在一个平面上，乙炔的 4 个原子排成一条线？: Why are the 6 atoms of ethene squeezed into one plane, and the 4 atoms of ethyne in a line?
把「当前分子」从乙烯拖到乙炔: Drag "current molecule" from ethene to ethyne
乙烯：6 个原子全落在同一块平面上，键角 120°，C=C 133 pm；换到乙: Ethene: all 6 atoms lie in one plane, bond angle 120°, C=C 133 pm. Switch to ethyne: 4 atoms in a straight line, bond angle 180°, C≡C 120 pm
乙烯里两个碳之间是双键，转不动，6 个原子被锁在同一个平面上，键角约 120°；: In ethene the two carbons share a double bond that cannot rotate, so the 6 atoms are locked in one plane with bond angles of about 120°. In ethyne it is a triple bond, even more rigid, locking the 4 atoms in a straight line at 180°. Drag "C—C single-bond rotation" and they do not budge; only single bonds like ethane's can rotate.
乙烯 6 个原子共平面，键角约 120°。: The 6 atoms of ethene are coplanar, bond angle about 120°.
乙炔 4 个原子共线，键角 180°。: The 4 atoms of ethyne are collinear, bond angle 180°.
C=C 133 pm、C≡C 120 pm，三键比双键更短。: C=C 133 pm, C≡C 120 pm: a triple bond is shorter than a double bond.
（拓展 · 选必3 p.34、p.37）双键是 1 个 σ 键 + 1 个 π: (Extension · Elective 3 p.34, p.37) A double bond is 1 σ bond + 1 π bond, a triple bond is 1 σ bond + 2 π bonds; the carbons are sp² and sp hybridized respectively.
去掉这一步：最容易把乙烯和乙炔的空间形状记混。: Skip this step and it is easy to mix up the shapes of ethene and ethyne.
考点：乙烯是平面形、乙炔是直线形。: Key point: ethene is planar, ethyne is linear.
双键、三键都转不动: Neither double nor triple bonds rotate
苯的 6 个碳碳键，为什么说它们完全一样长？: Why are the 6 carbon-carbon bonds of benzene said to be exactly the same length?
把苯转一圈，看 12 个原子是不是都落在同一块平面上: Spin benzene around and see whether all 12 atoms lie in the same plane
转到任何角度，12 个原子都贴着那块平面；6 个 C—C 键长都是 139 pm: At any angle all 12 atoms hug that plane; all 6 C—C bonds are 139 pm and all 6 angles between bonds are 120°
苯是平面正六边形，12 个原子共平面，键间夹角都是 120°。6 个碳碳键完全等: Benzene is a planar regular hexagon: 12 atoms are coplanar, and every angle between bonds is 120°. All 6 carbon-carbon bonds are identical at 139 pm, right between a single bond (154 pm) and a double bond (133 pm), so benzene has no alternating single and double bonds.
苯 12 个原子共平面，正六边形，键间夹角都是 120°。: The 12 atoms of benzene are coplanar in a regular hexagon, with all bond angles 120°.
6 个碳碳键等长，都是 139 pm。: All 6 carbon-carbon bonds are equal, 139 pm each.
139 pm 介于单键 154 pm 和双键 133 pm 之间。: 139 pm lies between a single bond (154 pm) and a double bond (133 pm).
去掉这一步：会以为苯里单双键交替、键长一长一短。: Skip this step and you may think benzene alternates single and double bonds, long and short.
考点：苯的平面正六边形结构与键长 139 pm。: Key point: benzene's planar regular hexagon and its 139 pm bond length.

在中控台把「支链」拨到开，让正丁烷变成异丁烷，保持 12 秒: On the console, turn "branch" on to change n-butane into isobutane and hold for 12 s
目标条变绿，模型停在带支链的异丁烷上: The target bar turns green and the model stays on branched isobutane
4 个碳的烷烃有两种结构：正丁烷是直链，异丁烷带支链。它们分子式都是 C₄H₁₀: The 4-carbon alkane has two structures: n-butane is a straight chain, isobutane is branched. Both are C₄H₁₀, but their skeletons differ, so they are two different compounds.
分子式相同、结构不同，就是同分异构体。: Same formula, different structure: that makes isomers.
碳骨架不同，物理性质就不同。: A different carbon skeleton gives different physical properties.

4 个氢共面，两个碳在平面外: 4 hydrogens coplanar, the two carbons outside that plane
6 个原子共平面，键角约 120°: All 6 atoms coplanar, bond angle about 120°
乙烯的碳原子 sp² 杂化，相邻键角约 120°，分子中所有原子都在同一平面。: Ethene's carbons are sp² hybridized; neighboring bond angles are about 120° and all atoms lie in one plane.

单双键交替，键长一长一短: Alternating single and double bonds, long and short
6 个碳碳键完全等同，键长 139 pm: All 6 carbon-carbon bonds identical, 139 pm long
苯是平面正六边形，6 个碳碳键完全等同，键长都是 139 pm，介于单键 154: Benzene is a planar regular hexagon; its 6 carbon-carbon bonds are identical at 139 pm, between a single bond (154 pm) and a double bond (133 pm).
正丁烷和异丁烷互为同分异构体，依据是: n-Butane and isobutane are isomers because
相对分子质量相同，性质相同: They have the same relative molecular mass and the same properties
分子式相同，碳骨架不同: They have the same formula but different carbon skeletons
沸点相同，熔点不同: They have the same boiling point but different melting points
都能燃烧生成二氧化碳和水: Both burn to give carbon dioxide and water
两者分子式都是 C₄H₁₀，但一个是直链、一个带支链，结构不同，所以互为同分异构: Both are C₄H₁₀, but one is a straight chain and the other is branched; their structures differ, so they are isomers.
